definitions.gloss: to swell, to become swollen, to be inflamed
definitions.explanation: To become enlarged or puffy due to injury, infection, or an allergic reaction. Used for body parts that puff up from a medical or physical cause.

examples.japanese: {足首|あしくび}が{腫|は}れている。
{虫|むし}に{刺|さ}されて{腕|うで}が{腫|は}れた。
examples.english: My arm swelled up after being bitten by an insect.

examples.japanese: {歯|は}が{痛|いた}くて{頬|ほほ}が{大|おお}きく{腫|は}れてしまった。
examples.english: I had a toothache and my cheek swelled up badly.

notes:
{腫|は}れる describes swelling of body parts from injury, infection, allergic reactions, or inflammation.

CONJUGATION:
Ichidan verb.
- Negative: {腫|は}れない
- Polite: {腫|は}れます
- Te-form: {腫|は}れて
- Past: {腫|は}れた
- Noun form: {腫|は}れ (swelling)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目|め}が{腫|は}れる: eyes become swollen (from crying or allergy)
- {足|あし}が{腫|は}れる: leg/foot swells
- {赤|あか}く{腫|は}れる: to swell up red
- {大|おお}きく{腫|は}れる: to swell up a lot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {膨|ふく}れる: to puff up, to inflate (not medical)
- {むくむ}: to be puffy, to have edema (water retention)
